people.summary: Published a six-pendulum cart-pole demonstration and described training an AI in his own environment. We credit the public work; its exact task and evaluation cohorts are not established as equivalent to this registry's ranked protocol.

people.name: Corben Sorenson
people.role: Published canonical task and fourteen-link release
people.summary: Published reset-free fourteen-link swing-up evidence under the canonical 50 Hz, ±80 N, ±3 m task. His source, frozen releases, validation gates, and explicit limitations anchor our matched campaign. The separate fifteen-link partial result remains unsolved in the cited release.
